sources.title: Medicare Program: Discarded Drugs and Biologicals – JW Modifier and JZ Modifier Policy, Frequently Asked Questions
sources.version: No date printed in the document. PDF metadata ModDate 2025-12-23 (created 2025-12-22); HTTP Last-Modified Tue, 23 Dec 2025 11:47:26 GMT

jwApplies.quote: Effective January 1, 2017, providers and suppliers are required to report the JW modifier on all claims that bill for drugs and biologicals (hereafter, drug) separately payable under Medicare Part B with unused and discarded amounts (hereafter, discarded amounts) from single-dose containers or single-use packages (hereafter, single-dose containers).

jzApplies.quote: Beginning no later than July 1, 2023: providers and suppliers are required to report the JZ modifier on all claims that bill for drugs from single-dose containers that are separately payable under Medicare Part B when there are no discarded amounts.

jzEffectiveDate.quote: Beginning no later than July 1, 2023, the JZ modifier is required to attest that there were no discarded amounts and no JW modifier amount is reported.
